paper_title: Search for invisible axion dark matter with a multiple-cell haloscope
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (converted from the stated limit of 11.1 x g_KSVZ using g_KSVZ ~ 3.97e-16 GeV^-1 x m_a[ueV])
notes: First results from the CAPP-9T double-cell cavity haloscope (arXiv:2008.10141). Excludes axion-photon coupling g_agamma >~ 11.1 x g_KSVZ at 90% CL over 13.0-13.9 ueV (3.14-3.36 GHz), assuming local axion DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3. Exact frequency-dependent limit is shown in Fig. 5 but no numerical table is provided; emitted points are the flat 11.1x KSVZ level converted to absolute GeV^-1 units at the mass range endpoints and midpoint.
